text_block_list.text:
—“Shocking.” That was how a certain race 
was described.

Escaping at a blistering pace right from 
the start. Continuing at an abnormal speed 
all the way to—the goal.

A course record. On top of that, an 
overwhelming victory, pulling 1.8 seconds 
ahead of the runner-up.

No one will ever surpass this race. That's 
what everyone thought, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Who is it?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Who will be the one? An unforgettable, 
historic run. Who is the only Umamusume 
capable of overturning it?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's me! Because I have to be the one 
to prove it.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing I can't do! Nothing 
impossible! I'll show them—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
To all those folks who assumed "there's no 
way she can do it" from the start!

text_block_list.name: Headband Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Tap!!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
Tap, go get 'em! Show 'em what you've 
got!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Yeah, watch me, everyone. And then—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle! I'll show you how it's 
done.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What you need to take on a challenge isn't 
some powerful backer. It's companions who 
share the same ambition!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh... Not a patron, but comrades...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So basically~ with the power of 
friendship, we help Suzuka-chan... is that 
it?

Doubt and disbelief. That was what 
everyone in the venue felt.

They said running faster than Silence 
Suzuka was impossible. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's on! The wind's always in our favor. 
Because—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I've got the cheers of my friends as a 
tailwind behind me! I'm gonna blow 
everyone away from start to finish!"
